ai_summary: Aarvi Encon Limited held its 38th Annual General Meeting on August 14, 2026, where members adopted the company's Audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Statements for FY2025-26. A key financial outcome was the declaration of a final dividend of Rs. 2/- per equity share for the fiscal year. While the Statutory Auditor's Report was clean, a minor yellow flag is noted as the Secretarial Auditor's Report contained an observation, which the company states has been addressed in the Board Report.
